messages:
ana: Quick check — AMS ILB plan for next week. We're turning on private ingress for Dedicated. Who owns egress policy + residency sign-off?
liam: I can take ILB config + canary routing. Will open a PR today and tag owners.
sara: Legal note: need explicit data flow map for backups & logs (where S3/metrics land). Without that we can't sign off for EU residency.
liam: @nish is tracking backup flows, right? nish: can you confirm KMS/region for backups?
nish: Confirmed — backups stay in eu-central-1, KMS key kms-redwood-eu. PR will include the flow diagram and kms arn.
ana: small nit: telemetry export also hits us-east for aggregation — should we mirror instead?
liam: good catch. For Dedicated customers we'll mirror metrics to eu-only; aggregation pipeline change tracked in infra#610.
sara: ok for legal once we see the flow diagram + explicit egress allowlist for S3 endpoints. Also need confirmation on log retention boundaries.
nish: adding policy snippet to PR so you can eyeball quickly:
```
networkPolicy:
  ingress:
    - from: private-subnet-ams
  egress:
    - to: s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com
    - to: kms.amazonaws.com (eu-central-1)
    - default: deny
```
liam: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/782 — contains canary playbook and smoke tests.
devops-bot: Canary deploy started for ams-ilb v2026.03.17-rc1. Logs: https://ci.redwood/987/logs (smoke 0/3 passing)
liam: investigating smoke failures now, should be quick fix (env var mismatch).
sara: once smoke passes can we set milestone: ILB go-live Fri 17:00 UTC? legal will file SLA update ticket if backups/retention confirmed.
ana: milestone sounds good. If we hit any egress exceptions we fallback to hosted-edge for affected customers.
nish: smoke fixed, tests passing, PR updated with diagram & retention table. @sara please review when you get a sec.
sara: Reviewing now. A couple small questions on retention durations, filing ticket #987 to adjust SLA language. :thumbsup:
liam: will merge after sara ack. I'll post final runbook in #oncall and ping owners.
ana: thanks everyone — ping here when PR merged and runbook up.
ish: merged, runbook up: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/ams-ilb, tagging ops.
liam: :thumbsup:
